What You'll Learn

Live weekend sessions — structured from foundation to execution so you trade with real confidence.

  • 1
    Introduction to Options Trading — Understand calls, puts, expiration dates, strike prices, and how options move with the market.
  • 2
    Trading Psychology — Master your mindset, eliminate emotional decision-making, and build the discipline that separates consistent traders.
  • 3
    Account Management — Learn how to structure your account, set realistic goals, and scale properly without blowing up.
  • 4
    Risk Management — Define your risk per trade, protect your capital, and stay in the game long enough to win.
  • 5
    How to Draw Key Levels — Identify critical support and resistance zones that institutions watch and react to.
  • 6
    Supply & Demand Zones — Spot high-probability reversal areas where smart money enters and exits the market.
  • 7
    Technical Indicators — Use the right tools at the right time — moving averages, RSI, MACD, volume, and more.
  • 8
    Putting It All Together — Build a complete, repeatable trading plan using everything learned and execute it live with your mentors.
